summary.zh: 按 WCAG 2.2 审计网站并给出修复建议
summary.en: Audit sites against WCAG 2.2 and plan remediation

description.zh: 结合自动化检测与人工验证，按 WCAG 2.2 逐项排查无障碍问题并给出修复建议。适合上线前审计、整改既有违规或统一设计规范时使用。需要能运行自动化检测工具并做人工复核。
description.en: Combines automated checks with manual verification to audit sites against WCAG 2.2 and propose fixes. Suits pre-launch audits, fixing violations or aligning design patterns. Requires automated tooling plus manual review.
